id.description: Unique snake_case identifier, stable across versions (other rules reference it via related_rules).

type.description: framework = from a named, published system; attributed_principle = credited to a person but not one treatise; general_craft = widely-taught convention with no single originator.

definition.description: Original-wording explanation of the concept -- never verbatim text from the source work.

detection_signal.description: The operational instruction: what an analyzer check should actually look for.

counter_considerations.description: Legitimate exceptions -- when NOT flagging is the correct call.

confidence_tier.description: How mechanically checkable this rule is, independent of how well-established the underlying theory is. Flows through to report framing (low tier => framed as a discussion prompt, not a verdict).

requires.description: What data this rule's check needs available to run.

related_rules.description: IDs of other rules in this knowledge base this one relates to or builds on.

genre.description: Genre this rule applies to. Null means cross-genre (applies to all). Genre-specific rules are only injected when the script's detected genre matches.
